column1: # One row per immutable (commit, path) pair whose added diff lines hold matches
# that are known not to be private data:
# The waiver drops the hits of that commit's diff to that path only when their
# number equals count exactly; any other number fails the scan. Waivers never
# apply to the working tree, to commit messages or to commit metadata. A real
# private value is an owner stop, never a waiver row.
